registered: 2026-10-06, before any Q3 computation (Test Lead: the failure is decision-level, so the quiz must be)

designs.task: each scenario: the candidate model, inside the fixed registered optimizer (EV4's decision rules: grid, constraints, tie rule, abstention), picks one protocol; the pick is checked against the scenario's pre-solved reference grid. The validator solves nothing.
designs.stand_in_pool: EV4's 12 verification scenarios (committed references; ev4-dev-tuning-v1 measures value on the development split only, so the pool is disjoint from it)
designs.basis: public stand-in only; the hidden batches' scenarios are produced operator-side

metric.gate: decision-level false-feasible: the share of the k scenarios (with a resolved outcome) whose pick the reference shows infeasible (SELECTED_INFEASIBLE)
also: regret: mean decision loss over the k scenarios
over-caution: the share of the k scenarios that are MISSED_OPPORTUNITY (abstained or too slow where a feasible design existed)
metric.detection: AUC over draws of k scenarios (without replacement): P(gate of a known-bad member > gate of a known-good member); mean and 5th percentile, per k
metric.known_bad: as v3: the 8 EV5 Track A constructions and the run-5 winner
metric.known_good: as v3: the 3 controls and the best quarter of EV4's real members by development decision value
metric.comparison: against v3's Q2 at matching producer cost: one Q3 scenario costs the grid's 35 reference solves
